Download a release file, verified and cached

Source: R/download.R
cmgd_download.Rd

Downloads a file into the cache (keyed by its URL) and returns the local path. Files listed in the release's indexes are verified by size and SHA-256: table files, per-study files, the DuckLake catalog, the gene-family indexes, and gene-family files from a study already listed with cmgd_genefamilies() on the same release handle. A mismatching download is deleted and an error raised. A cached file that still verifies is not downloaded again.

Usage

cmgd_download(rel, path_or_url, cache = cmgd_cache_dir())

Arguments

rel

A release from cmgd_release().

path_or_url

A path relative to the release URL (as in the path column of cmgd_files() or cmgd_study_files()) or a full URL (as in the url column of cmgd_genefamilies()).

cache

Cache directory.

Value

The local file path.

Examples

rel <- cmgd_release("cmgd_mpa4.2-2.3.0", release = "2026-10-16")
path <- cmgd_download(rel, "studies/ZellerG_2014/qc.tsv",
    cache = tempdir()
)
path
#> [1] "/tmp/Rtmp7wegWj/cmgd-public.cancerdatasci.org/cmgd_mpa4.2-2.3.0/2026-10-16/studies/ZellerG_2014/qc.tsv"
